title: Transport authority boundary
summary: Queue Transport owns the remote TCP confidentiality/authentication/admission mechanism. It does not own queue semantics, channel semantics, durable persistence formats, placement decisions, WLU admission, receiver ACLs, or application delivery idempotence.
invariants: Local/in-process queue operations are not encrypted merely because remote transport is encrypted.
Channel and queue-manager semantics remain above the socket transport.
Receiver channel/ACL authority remains above transport admission.
Transport crypto must not be moved into Job-to-Node Allocator, WLU, or persistence code.

provenance.claim: Purpose and fail-closed scope distinguish remote transport from queue, placement and WLU authorities.
Source states confidentiality/IP admission while channel and queue-manager semantics remain above the layer.
Validation records receiver channel/ACL and durable idempotence as authorities above transport admission.
